title: Law to require yearly checks that cooling towers are registered
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings to compile an annual list of properties with cooling towers and cross-reference it against registration and certification records to find non-compliant properties. Owners found in violation would have to disinfect their cooling towers within a set time, and vacant properties would have to stop using non-compliant towers until they come into compliance. Owners could avoid these requirements by providing sworn documentation showing compliance or that no cooling tower is present.
